# Sample data
* `case1/` - 27 of the 262 provided scanner frames: all frames named after a deliberate edge case plus 12 random normal frames (10 MB). The full dataset is the link in the brief; `outputs/sample_outputs/parcel_provided_dataset_results.csv` is the system's output for **all 262**.
* `case2/` - the provided sample wagesheet and the two sample ECR PDFs, unchanged.
* `case3/Case_Study_3.xlsx` - the provided workbook, unchanged; `case3_extended_sample.csv` - generated by `python -m app.pnl.datagen` (seeded): 4 synthetic FCs x 30 days with the required scenarios + the first 30 provided days as a 5th FC.
No real personal data is included (the Case 2 identifiers are the brief's placeholders).
